summary: BIOXIC round 3 — Tested 4 new features: Logo modal 3D, chat reactions (fire/crown/heart), playlist grouping, admin chat moderation. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (15 existing + 9 new in test_new_features.py covering PATCH playlist, admin chat GET/DELETE/BAN auth+broadcast, fire/crown/invalid reactions). Frontend: Logo modal opens via data-testid=channel-logo, 3D tilt confirmed (card.style.transform changes from 'rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg)' to 'rotateX(7.33deg) rotateY(-7.71deg)' on mousemove), 'atinge logo-ul' hint visible, X close works, backdrop close works. Playlist flow: PATCH /admin/tracks/{id} with playlist='Seif Exclusives' persists, /piese renders element [data-testid='playlist-group-Seif Exclusives'] correctly; clearing playlist (empty string) also works and track regroups under 'Single-uri'. Reactions: WS reaction/fire + reaction/crown broadcast to other sessions (verified via backend ws test). Chat heart (type:'tap') increments like_count and broadcasts reaction. Admin chat list GET /admin/chat auth-gated OK. Admin DELETE /admin/chat/{id} works at API (admin UI confirms 'Mesaj șters.'). Admin ban POST /admin/chat/ban works at API (backend test passes — banned user receives {type:'error'} and msg not broadcast). Playlist left EMPTY at end as required.

minor.issue: db.chat.delete_many uses raw b.name (case-sensitive) while banned_names is stored lowercased. If admin bans 'TrollTest' it only deletes msgs named exactly 'TrollTest' but future msgs from 'trolltest' are still blocked via lowercased lookup. Minor consistency issue — rarely hit in practice because frontend sends consistent casing.

ui_bugs.issue: The bottom 'Înapoi la muzică' close button (data-testid=logo-modal-close) is visually overlapped by the fixed floating player-bar at the bottom of the viewport on desktop (1366x900). Playwright reports player-bar subtree 'intercepts pointer events' on the close button. Real users with viewport heights that put the modal card near the bottom cannot click this close button. Users can still close via the top-right X button and backdrop click, so UX is not fully broken.

When admin deletes a chat message from /admin, the backend broadcasts {type:'delete', id} via WS (verified at backend layer) but in the live browser session the deleted message is NOT removed from [data-testid=chat-messages]. The handler exists at LiveChat.jsx:46 (setMessages filter by id) — possible reasons: WS reconnection losing in-flight delete, stale state closure, or inactive-tab throttling. Needs E1 investigation.

integration_issues.issue: In automated browser test the banned user still successfully posted after ban. Backend test PASSES the ban flow (banned user WS receives {type:'error'} and msg is not broadcast). Suspected root cause: Admin.jsx banName() uses window.confirm() which blocks JS; Playwright dialog handler using create_task(d.accept()) may race and not accept, so ban never fires in the browser test. Not necessarily a product bug but window.confirm is a UX smell (modal, non-stylable, blocks test automation). Recommend replacing with a styled confirm.

issues: Floating player-bar z-index exceeds LogoModal (z-[100]) and overlaps bottom CTA inside the modal card. Either bump LogoModal to z-[150] or hide/dim player-bar while a full-screen modal is open.

action_items: Bump z-index of LogoModal above the floating player-bar (or hide player-bar while bio modal is open) so [data-testid=logo-modal-close] is clickable.

Investigate LiveChat delete broadcast: in the browser the deleted message is not removed from [data-testid=chat-messages] even though backend emits {type:'delete',id}. Check WS keepalive/reconnect and the setMessages filter closure.
Replace window.confirm in Admin.jsx banName() with a styled confirm dialog; makes feature testable and better UX. (Backend ban logic is correct and verified.)
Minor: in POST /admin/chat/ban, use case-insensitive delete_many (e.g., regex ^name$/i) so historic messages from any casing variant of the banned name are also wiped.
critical_code_review_comments: LogoModal has fixed z-[100] but PlayerBar is a global fixed element presumably with higher z-index. Modal overlays must guarantee top layer — consider a shared Portal with z management or hide player while modal open.

LiveChat.jsx: no WS ping/keepalive timer visible; connections may drop silently in background tabs and miss broadcasts (delete, reaction) until reconnect. Backend sends history on reconnect but does NOT replay 'delete' events — a stale client may show already-deleted messages until forced refresh.
server.py chat_ws: still routes WS at app.websocket('/api/ws/chat') while REST uses api_router — consider consistency. Still 1450+ lines; split into routers (previous iteration note still open).
No rate limiting on chat WS (previous iteration note still open).
window.confirm in banName — unstyled and blocks UI; replace with modal.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up ~6 test chat messages (del_mark_*, troll_del_*, after_ban_*, DelTestR3, TrollTestR3). Playlist on sole track reset to '' as required. Also added 'DelTestR3' and 'TrollTestR3' to banned_names via the ban test flow — if main agent wants a clean slate, run: await db.banned_names.delete_many({name:{$in:['deltestr3','trolltestr3']}}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest covers 24 cases across 3 files. Key new testids verified: channel-logo, logo-modal, logo-modal-card (style.transform tilt), logo-modal-close (BLOCKED by player-bar at desktop 1366x900 bottom), chat-fire-button, chat-crown-button, chat-heart-button, admin-playlist-input, admin-track-playlist-{id}, playlist-group-{name}, playlist-filter-{name|toate}, admin-chat-list, admin-chat-refresh, admin-chat-delete-{id}, admin-chat-ban-{id}. Admin ban uses window.confirm — handle dialog in playwright. On /piese body.innerText may not surface h3 text; use querySelector('[data-testid=playlist-group-...]') instead.
rca of the issue: LogoModal close-button obstruction: PlayerBar component (fixed positioning, likely z-index > 100) renders above LogoModal (z-[100]). Fix: raise LogoModal to z-[150+] or conditionally hide player while bio modal is open. Chat delete not reflecting in session B: backend broadcast works (verified via pytest WS test). Suspect LiveChat.jsx closure over setMessages or background-tab WS pause. Ban in Playwright: window.confirm dialog not reliably accepted by test → ban API never fires → no block observed. Backend ban logic works per test_admin_ban_blocks_future_messages.
